name: 38-add-openrouter-signatures-anthropic
description: addOpenRouterSignatures (prompt-converters.js:1397-1451) with an `anthropic/claude-...` model, so `getFormatForModel` (:1398-1412) returns 'anthropic-claude-v1'. Both signature sources feed one list, in order: the message's own `signature` first, then one detail per `tool_calls` entry, and each detail's `index` is its position in that list while its `id` is the tool call's own `id` (or `signature-<index>` when there is none). Every `signature` property is deleted afterwards. The second message has no signature anywhere and is untouched, and the third's non-string `signature` is neither emitted nor deleted (:1433 is a `typeof === 'string'` test).
